Ana (PM): Heads-up  pilots asked to move bulk embeddings into MVP. This conflicts with our v1 model-pin timeline. Need a scope call.
Ravi (Eng): Can pilots tolerate a gated rollout?
Priya (CS): They want nightly bulk + interactive latency guarantee. Willing to pay for reserved capacity if we commit.
Omar (Infra): We have a maintenance window next week; Dedicated slots drop ~30%. Autoscale helps for short bursts but sustained nightly jobs will queue.
Ana (PM): Options: full include (higher ops), delay bulk to v1, or hybrid (public MVP no bulk, pilots get reserved carve-outs).
Ravi (Eng): Hybrid seems lowest risk: public ship stays on schedule, pilots get the feature behind an org flag.
Linh (Design): If hybrid, hide batch-upload for public and add a "Pilot: bulk uploads enabled" badge in org settings.
Jo (Data): Need quotas and a nightly window. Suggest 02:00-06:00 UTC and a soft cap at 8M tokens/night for pilot carve.
Omar (Infra): I can provision reserved slots: 2 GPUs nightly for pilot orgs. Lead time ~48 hours to test. Add routing + canary.
Ravi (Eng): Implementation plan: 1d feature flag, 2d routing + tests, 1d canary. Fallback routing to quantized model on overload.
Priya (CS): I'll secure verbal OK today and push for written MOU. If no MOU by EOD+2, we auto-disable pilot bulk.
Ana (PM): Acceptance for pilot carve: - up to 8M tokens/night - interactive p50 <=250ms - alerts at queue >50% - signed MOU for billing.
Ravi (Eng): I'll open PRs and include a checklist: flag, routing, fallback, canary script, smoke tests.
Omar (Infra): I'll add dashboard panels: queue depth, token/sec, reserved utilization, p50/p95. Alerting at >50% queue.
Linh (Design): I'll update UI microcopy and create the hidden UX states.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/pilot-bulk-gate -> staging at 2189990030
Ravi (Eng): Staging canary ready; will post metrics.
Jo (Data): I'll run a simulated nightly ingest to verify queue behavior under reserved carve.
Priya (CS): Customers verbally OK; legal needs written MOU.
Ana (PM): Decision: Hybrid approach approved. Action owners: Ravi (flag+routing), Omar (provision+dash), Linh (UI), Priya (contracts), Jo (smoke tests). Reopen if capacity or legal blocks appear. :thumbsup:
